correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the complete polynomial generator for Qdot=mu Q-VD, Ddot=-nu D+VQ, Vdot=Gamma-V+QD. Stationarity of arbitrary single-coordinate antiderivative tests gives E[VD|Q]=mu Q, E[VQ|D]=nu D, E[QD|V]=V-Gamma. The independent SymPy check verifies L((Q^2+D^2)/2)=mu Q^2-nu D^2 and all three signed residual identities. Conditional residual orthogonality yields Var(VD)-mu^2 Var(Q)=E[Qdot^2], Var(VQ)-nu^2 Var(D)=E[Ddot^2] and Var(QD)-Var(V)=E[Vdot^2]. If both Q,D energies vanish, invariance on axis Q=D=0 and bounded complete trajectories of Vdot=Gamma-V force the single atom (0,0,Gamma). Nonzero energies have RMS(D)/RMS(Q)=sqrt(mu/nu); at mu=119/1000,nu=1/10 exactly sqrt(119)/10. Compact support justifies integrations; no sampled orbit is used to prove stationarity.
